shadow-md.$description: RX-125 UIX-03 — a hover lift between sm and popover (the interactive card referenced it; it was never defined).

ease-in.$description: Kept for compatibility only. An accelerating curve on something the user watches reads as lag, so exits use --uix-ease-out at a --uix-dur-exit-* duration; check-motion.mjs fails component CSS that uses ease-in.

ease-in-out.$description: Movement already on screen (a strong in-out, easeInOutQuart). The spec's older cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) was never shipped; this value is canonical.

ease-glide.$description: A mark gliding between items already on screen (the hover highlight in a menu, listbox or sidebar; the current page; a tooltip moving to its neighbour). A damped spring (stiffness 550, damping 43, mass 1) sampled into linear(): no overshoot, 95 % of the way after about 175 ms, settled at --uix-dur-glide. A new target retargets a running glide from where it is.

ease-pop.$description: A control growing in from its trigger (tooltip, menu, the radio dot). A livelier spring (stiffness 800, damping 42): 95 % after about 110 ms, a 3 % overshoot of the travel (a scale from .9 peaks at 1.003), settled at --uix-dur-pop. Controls only: never on data or status, which never overshoot.

scrim-blur.$description: How far a modal dialog or drawer blurs the page behind its scrim (2.60). The radius is constant and only the scrim's opacity animates (an animated radius re-renders a full-page blur every frame and starves software rendering, e.g. VDI desktops without a GPU). Set it to 0px to turn the blur off.

stagger-rows.$description: Rows of a list that just opened (a select's options, a menu's items, a sidebar group's rows) arrive this far apart, top to bottom (2.60). Only the first ten step; the rest arrive with the tenth, so a long list is complete within about 600 ms.

dur-glide.$description: Paired with --uix-ease-glide: the spring's settle time. It reads as about 175 ms; the tail is sub-pixel.

dur-pop.$description: Paired with --uix-ease-pop: the spring's settle time. It reads as about 110 ms.

dur-exit-fast.$description: Exit paired with --uix-dur-fast (about two-thirds of the enter). Exits are faster than enters and never ease-in.

dur-exit.$description: Exit paired with --uix-dur (popovers, menus, select, toasts).

dur-exit-slow.$description: Exit paired with --uix-dur-slow (modal, drawer, side peek).

dur-highlight.$description: How long an arrival or change tint takes to fade back to the row colour. Not a transition budget: the tint is a held signal, not movement.

dur-change.$description: How long a change tint (ChangeHighlight, .uix-changed) takes to fade on the row or field that changed. Shorter than --uix-dur-highlight: a change in place, not a landing.

delay-pending.$description: How long a pending action waits before it shows a pending indicator: a spinner that would flash for less is noise.

hold-pending.$description: Once a pending indicator shows, the least time it stays, so it never flickers.

hold-result.$description: How long an in-place result (a button's success or error state, a copied check) holds before it returns to rest.

delay-tooltip.$description: Hover delay before a tooltip opens. Keyboard focus opens it at once.

delay-tooltip-skip.$description: Delay-group window: a neighbouring tooltip hovered within this long after one closed opens at once.

loop-spin.$description: One turn of a spinner (Spinner, Button loading, a running flow node).

loop-shimmer.$description: One pass of the skeleton shimmer.

loop-pulse.$description: One cycle of the reduced-motion opacity pulse that replaces spinners, shimmer and indeterminate progress, so a still-working indicator stays visibly alive without movement.

dur-arrive.$description: Arrival (calm kit 2.56): how long one card of a glance page takes to fade and rise into place on the first paint of a session. Never on a refresh or a data change.

stagger-arrive.$description: Arrival: the gap between one card starting and the next, in reading order.

delay-arrive-trace.$description: Arrival: how long after its card starts a chart begins to draw (a line traces, bars grow).

dur-arrive-trace.$description: Arrival: a line or sparkline tracing in from the left.

dur-arrive-grow.$description: Arrival: one bar growing from its baseline (paired bars, a bar list, a meter).

stagger-arrive-grow.$description: Arrival: the gap between one bar (or bucket) starting to grow and the next.

dur-arrive-count.$description: Arrival: a headline number counting up from zero (Count arrive). Later changes tick once instead.

arrive-rise.$description: Arrival: how far a card rises while it fades in.

z-raised.$description: z-index ladder (semantic stacking order). raised = locally lifted within a component: a sticky table header & first column, a flow node title over its diamond, a heartbeat dot over its ping.

z-sticky.$description: A sticky plane that must outrank raised siblings — the pinned-column header corner, which sits above both the sticky row and the sticky column.

z-dropdown.$description: Detached layers anchored to a trigger: menus, selects, comboboxes, popovers.

z-overlay.$description: Full-viewport overlays and their backdrops: modal, drawer, side-peek, lightbox.

z-tooltip.$description: Tooltips — above overlays so a tip raised from inside a dialog stays visible.

z-toast.$description: Toasts / transient notifications — top of the stack.
